note: A documentation site built and deployed on push to the protected main: mkdocs build, then GitHub's own configure, upload and deploy pages actions, with contents: read plus the pages and id-token writes the deploy action needs. Only GitHub-owned actions run, which the shipped configuration trusts, the branch is protected, and nothing else enters the job, so no path is anchored. Had a third-party action built the site, its path would reach the github-pages environment (a deploys impact) and the id-token and pages write tokens: Critical. The id-token write alone is a privilege, never a signs_or_releases impact, since no signing or release step runs.
